mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.real_name, u.dept_id, u.phone, u.email, u.status, u.last_login_time, u.create_time, d.dept_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.id WHERE u.id = #{id}

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.real_name, u.dept_id, u.phone, u.email, u.status, u.last_login_time, u.create_time, d.dept_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.id WHERE u.dept_id = #{deptId} ORDER BY u.create_time DESC

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.real_name, u.dept_id, u.phone, u.email, u.status, u.last_login_time, u.create_time, d.dept_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id WHERE ur.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY u.create_time DESC
SELECT id, username, password, real_name, dept_id, phone, email, status, last_login_time, create_time, update_time FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username}
